stories.title: Add GPG key management for release signing
stories.description: Implement GPG key management to sign all release artifacts before deployment to ensure authenticity. This requires installing the GPG toolchain as a rare external dependency on every CI runner.
acceptanceCriteria: GPG keys are generated and stored securely in the key store
All release artifacts are signed with the GPG key before deployment

stories.title: Track story velocity metrics over time
stories.description: Add a feature to record how many stories pass per iteration so operators can track velocity trends across SPIRAL runs and identify slowdowns early.
